origin.birthplace: Nowhere in particular — he travels the trade roads
origin.socialStatus: A wealthy merchant without a title

appearance.face: A fleshy face, small sly eyes, a smile with one gold tooth
appearance.hairAndEyes: Oiled, combed hair, a thin moustache, brown eyes
appearance.clothing: Colourful, expensive clothes, purses on his belt, a small pair of scales
appearance.build: Stout but nimble, leaning slightly forward
appearance.gestures: Weighs everything with his eyes; fingers coins to check they are real
appearance.firstImpression: A pleasant, smooth-talking merchant — yet everyone guards their purse
appearance.artistNotes: His scales are slightly miscalibrated in his favour.

backstory.biography: Tobias travels from town to town selling everything: spices, cloth, weapons and rumours. His deals are always legal on paper but rarely honest. He never asks where the goods come from as long as the price is right. He has a debtor in every town and an unhappy customer in every other one.
backstory.whyHere: He sees the table as a market. There are rich and desperate people here, and he wants to buy cheap and sell dear.
backstory.secret: That much of his wealth comes from deals that would not survive careful inspection.

psychology.weakness: Believes everyone has a price and underestimates principled people
psychology.desire: To become the richest merchant in the kingdom
psychology.angers: Broken contracts — when they hurt him
psychology.moralLimits: Never breaks a contract while it profits him

behavior.stakes: Only when the odds are calculated
behavior.alliances: Alliances are contracts. Kept while profitable
behavior.whenRetreats: When the risk outweighs the profit

motives.hiddenGoal: To leave with more than he came with — and new debtors
motives.helpTrigger: If the help creates a debt

speech.howLies: Convincingly and confidently. Has an answer for everything

mechanics.strangeness: His scales tip by themselves a moment before someone at the table lies about a price.
mechanics.principle: Never gives anything away for free.
mechanics.temptation: Believes everyone has a price and underestimates principled people
mechanics.ability: Middleman: once per evening he swaps cards between two other players for 1 gold.
mechanics.hostRelation: Debt — he sees the host as the biggest customer he has ever had.

authorNotes.distinctive: A pure trader: every hand is a market and every player a customer.
authorNotes.tunable: How aggressively he offers deals and loans.

lines.text: Good evening! Tobias Greaves, at your service. Everything has a price, friends.
Hm. A temporary loss. The market fluctuates.
Me? I am an honest merchant. I have papers!
An alliance? Of course! How much will you pay me?
The contract was clear. You will pay.
Tobias Greaves, the Scales. He will sell you your own boots — and convince you it was a bargain.
Ah, a returning customer! Prices have gone up a little, you understand.

tells.description: Fingers his coins to check they are real

relations.story: Silas has owed him money for three towns now.
relations.effect: Tobias often turns his attacks on Silas.
